11 days Golden Triangle with Jim Corbett tour

Delhi · Jaipur · Agra · Jim Corbett · 11 days

11 days Wildlife tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Delhi, Jaipur and Agra at an easy pace, then four days in the foothills of the Himalaya at Jim Corbett — India's oldest national park, with tigers, wild elephants and river forests.

At a glance

Duration
11 days, 10 nights
Start / end
Delhi / Delhi
Park
Jim Corbett National Park
Safaris
Two jeep safaris and an elephant safari
Transport
Private AC car throughout
Tour type
Private
Best season
November to June

What makes this one worth it

  • The full Golden Triangle — Delhi, Jaipur and Agra — with a guide in each city
  • Jim Corbett, India's first national park, in the Himalayan foothills
  • Jeep and elephant safaris for tigers, wild elephants, deer and crocodiles
  • Over 600 species of birds along the Ramganga river
  • The Taj Mahal at sunrise and Fatehpur Sikri on the way

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Arrive in Delhi

    Airport pickup and transfer to your hotel. The evening is free.

  2. Day 2

    Delhi sightseeing

    Chandni Chowk, the Red Fort and Jama Masjid in Old Delhi, then Qutub Minar, the Lotus Temple and Akshardham.

  3. Day 3

    Delhi to Jaipur

    About five hours to Jaipur. Check in and spend the evening at leisure.

  4. Day 4

    Jaipur sightseeing

    Up to Amber Fort, then the City Palace, Jantar Mantar, Hawa Mahal and Birla Temple.

  5. Day 5

    Jaipur to Agra via Fatehpur Sikri

    On the way to Agra, the abandoned Mughal city of Fatehpur Sikri — Salim Chishti's tomb and the Panch Mahal.

  6. Day 6

    Taj Mahal and Agra

    The Taj Mahal at sunrise, Agra Fort and the Baby Taj with your guide.

  7. Day 7

    Agra to Jim Corbett

    A long drive north to the foothills — about seven hours. Check in at your wildlife resort and rest.

  8. Day 8

    Jeep safaris in Corbett

    Morning and afternoon jeep safaris through sal forest and grassland — tigers, elephants, spotted deer and the gharial in the Ramganga river.

  9. Day 9

    Elephant safari and the outdoors

    An elephant safari, then a free afternoon for river walks, Corbett Falls or the Garjia temple on its rock in the Kosi river.

  10. Day 10

    Corbett to Delhi

    A morning nature walk with a naturalist, then about six hours back to Delhi.

  11. Day 11

    Departure

    Breakfast and transfer to the airport or station for your onward journey.

Questions people ask

Which zone of Corbett will we visit?
Bijrani or Jhirna for day safaris, or Dhikala if you want to stay inside the park — Dhikala permits open 45 days ahead and go fast.
When is Corbett open?
Dhikala and Bijrani close for the monsoon, roughly mid-June to mid-October. Jhirna stays open year-round.
Is the drive from Agra too long?
It is the longest leg of the tour, about seven hours. We can break it with a night in Delhi if you prefer.
Can we skip Jaipur?
Yes. A shorter seven-day version keeps Delhi, Agra and Corbett.
